local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the diff c696391..9718de20 for com.netflix.graphql.dgs:graphql-dgs-client:10.5.0 against every enumerated rule in review-library-new-request and the first matching disposition in FS-contribution-contract.5. Diff shape: one coordinate and one version, with only metadata/<v>/reachability-metadata.json, index.json, stats (stats.json and execution-metrics.json) and tests/src/<v>/ files. No build logic, workflows or other coordinates are touched, and no legacy *-config.json files appear. The metadata file contains no test-package (com_netflix_graphql_dgs) types, so test-only metadata stays separate from library metadata. The index.json entry has exactly one latest, tested-versions [10.5.0] and allowed-packages [com.netflix.graphql.dgs.client], and the local index validation gate passed. Test: Graphql_dgs_clientTest is a public class in the separate package com_netflix_graphql_dgs.graphql_dgs_client. It drives GraphQLResponse parsing, GraphQLClient.createCustom with a RequestExecutor, HTTP error handling and custom-scalar GraphQLRequestOptions through the public API and asserts observable results. It is not a scaffold. It has no native-image skip or catch(Error), no version string, no test-side reflection, no stubs or shadow classes, no JVM overrides and no hand-written metadata. build.gradle adds only plain dependencies (jackson-databind, assertj) and no graalvmNative build or run flags. The src/test/resources/META-INF/native-image/reachability-metadata.json is the harness-collected test-only metadata, the same shape committed by the other 1000+ test projects. Coverage: dynamic access is 0/0, a valid no-calls case, so the 20% gate and the entry-count mismatch probe do not apply. Disposition: no violation, so 5.1 to 5.5 are not triggered. I ran the Forge finalization command; it exited 0 after all three test lanes, metadata and style checks, generated-test validity and stats, and it left the tree unchanged (git status clean apart from the review scratch directory), so no repair was needed.
